study.question: Does the useful auxiliary context gradient through the compressed-history task adapter originate from cart/favorite supervision, purchase supervision, or an interaction between these two fixed task groups?
study.hypothesis: Observation: round31 adapter-context-only click AUC0.667057510 exceeded all-context-blocked0.666805196, tower-only0.666822363 and both-enabled0.666900009. Round32 repeated the blocked-item bridge exactly, while target-only0.666809831, summary-only0.666326995 and both-item-enabled0.666189529 were worse. These are single-seed controlled observations, not repeated support. The remaining useful shared path aggregates three auxiliary losses with different labels and sparsity; its task source is unmeasured. Provisional directional hypothesis: cart/favorite context gradients provide most of its useful adaptation while purchase context gradients are redundant or interfere. The purchase task has4036 validation positives versus10428 cart and7717 favorite, motivating uncertainty rather than proving noisier training gradients. Neither current labels nor positive-only samples gate forward execution. All three losses and all auxiliary head/adapter parameters remain trained. Earlier compressed-task0.659194239 and shared-curvature0.663727050 trajectories failed to beat their nearest alternatives; support-query-only0.664615577 also underperformed attached-input0.666753548. Those failures show selective detachment is not universally helpful. The imported DIN baseline0.655544082 and source bests0.660646940/0.660163363 remain predictive references. Incumbent improves click while auxiliary AUCs0.778674/0.803178/0.756152 are below DIN0.849070/0.864897/0.870182: no claim of improvement on every task or joint mean.

nearest_work.difference: Read archived primary text lines250-335: inherit target-aware unnormalized local activation and Dice; retained compressed/moment summaries and task adapters are prior local work. New difference is fixed task-source selection on the auxiliary adapter-context gradient, not a DIN reproduction or a new attention mechanism.

Read original v1 https://arxiv.org/pdf/2508.11565v1 sections1 and3.2 via public PDF, plus pinned benchmark forward/block source unirank-code:INFNet lines123-219. INFNet performs proxy-based cross-type attention and task-aware interaction. This suite uses a fixed backward context-edge selection within the existing compressed-history model; no proxy architecture is adopted. Originality relative to the wider gradient-routing literature remains unverified.

Read pinned upstream Dice lines25-34 (SHA256 a956a5b1836b3ba5552a910314960094be644d45112ffc0ab3e7799f701ddc3c): native BatchNorm plus learned alpha is inherited exactly. This intervention adds no normalization population, running state or learned gate.

study.proposed_difference: Add aux_adapter_context_tasks as a fixed list of auxiliary schema names. During training only, detach adapter_context for nonselected auxiliary labels; leave the selected adapter-context operand attached. Use the full 2x2 design N=none, E=cart+fav, P=buy, A=all. Per-task adapters, prediction arithmetic and four-task losses remain present in every cell. All-task/none bridges test execution fidelity and attribution to this edge; no capacity or new architecture claim.
predictions: At identical model state all four cells must give matching four-task probabilities and native buffer updates, including training, and identical evaluation behavior; new selection adds no parameter/buffer/RNG operations. All-task bridge should reproduce incumbent0.667057510 and none bridge0.666805196 under the frozen recipe, within host-reported reproducibility tolerance. Exact bridge repetition is not independent mechanism evidence.

At nondegenerate host probe states with each zero-initialized adapter output deliberately opened, the isolated auxiliary task loss must have zero context-operand Jacobian for disabled tasks and a permitted, generically nonzero Jacobian for enabled tasks; click context derivative remains permitted. Every auxiliary adapter and tower remains trainable. Their initial zero-output construction alone is not a valid isolation probe.

Directional prediction: E exceeds N and A, while P offers little gain over N. Compute both conditional effects E-N and A-P for cart/fav, P-N and A-E for purchase, and interaction A-E-P+N. A winning A instead would support complementary groups provisionally and contradict the proposed selective-improvement direction.

Select by full-population click AUC only after correctness gates. Require at least0.0001 absolute AUC gain over incumbent and an admissible measured cost before prioritizing a partial cell for confirmation; this is a practical follow-up threshold, not statistical significance. Report all four AUC/logloss values, auxiliary mean separately, parameters, GPU/train/wall seconds, peak memory, throughput and batch p50/p95.

Use existing fixed history bins empty/1-16/17-64/>64 as secondary diagnostics with sample/positive/negative counts (negatives=samples-positives). Host per-task loss or gradient diagnostics, if offered, consume budget. Other hour/composition/frequency/missing slices are exploratory only when supplied by the authorized evaluator; unavailable diagnostics remain unavailable.
falsifiers: E failing to exceed A by the predeclared practical threshold does not support the proposed selective improvement. P matching/exceeding E or A exceeding both partials contradicts concentration in cart/favorite; report the observed conditional effects rather than forcing the initial explanation.

Any changed fixed-state probability/buffer update, unintended context/item/scorer gradient, altered loss/learned initialization, mask failure, nonfinite BF16 value, checkpoint mismatch or failed bridge blocks mechanism interpretation until corrected. Failed checks/costs remain recorded.

Effects explained by global clipping, gradient magnitude or optimizer accumulator changes cannot establish semantic task complementarity. Further matched-gradient/optimizer diagnostics would be a separate prospective experiment under the same protocol, not post hoc proof.

A single-seed gain, even over both source bests, does not establish mechanism replication or held-out improvement. Material cost inflation removes any equal-cost claim; no claim of auxiliary-task Pareto improvement is made.
alternative_explanations: Cart and favorite are grouped: the suite cannot distinguish their individual contributions. These labels do not establish a purchase funnel or advertisement-attributed conversions.

Auxiliary prevalence, gradient magnitude/direction, shared embedding Adagrad accumulators, dense global clipping and single-pass optimization differ as consequences of the intervention. This is edge-level optimization attribution, not parameter isolation or proof of semantic transfer.

Single frozen seed and repeated validation-guided choices: no significance or generalization claim. Exact same-seed bridges are not independent support; lack of per-task Jacobian diagnostics is unresolved until host checks.
Statically identical forward operators do not prove tensor/BF16 equality, optimizer equivalence, tensor masking or cost. The host must verify these before interpreting score differences.

Disabling an edge can regularize optimization or change exposure-frequency weighting without transferring task-specific predictive information. Purchase validation sparsity does not measure its training gradient quality.

Auxiliary heads and adapters retain gradients; their dense norm can still change the globally clipped click update even when their context operands are detached. Shared embedding tables/aliases, if any, require host inspection before claims about source ownership.
Official auxiliary targets match user/category/brand within24h, not advertisement-specific conversions; grouping cart/fav versus buy is an intervention partition, not an assumed causal sequence.
